stale_rows.stated_choice: The condition channel approaches the applicability domain of the selected challenge.
stale_rows.actual_choice: condition_distance is computed exclusively from goal.conditions. It never measures distance to the selected inequality.conditions; outside that domain challenge reward uses -1e6.
stale_rows.why_it_matters: Task eligibility and inequality applicability are deliberately different domains. The current sentence conflates them and promises a gradient that is not implemented.
stale_rows.minimal_fix: Say explicitly that the condition channel approaches task conditions only; do not imply it approaches arbitrary selected-inequality conditions. No new mechanism is required for this sweep.

verdict_scope: Current unresolved findings only are in the top-level arrays. The complete original findings are retained below. Clean, if reached, remains provisional and does not establish a Q8 result or a theorem from sample support.

undeclared.decision: Novelty is nearest normalized L1 distance in a fixed projection: edges, even_squares, degree_3..6 when present, holes_max_side. New registry metrics do not automatically enter this projection; labelled edge sets are not isomorphism classes. Archive-parent scoring may use leave-one-out, candidate scoring must not.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Defines what structural diversity means and which constructions are retained or rewarded.
undeclared.resolution: Declared in A12; candidate/archive distinction also fixed under F01.

undeclared.decision: Discovery/challenge assignment uses graph-ID suffix modulo 4, with fallback to the first graph. Clusters use odd-square status, edges//4 and minimum degree; only the 48 densest individual discovery rows are shown.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Defines the empirical sample and correlations the upper model can see. It is not independent statistical validation.
undeclared.resolution: Declared in A13 and existing A08; all applicable archived graphs remain checked.

undeclared.decision: Each focus uses specific scalar coefficients and a target-dependent penalty: objective - (abs(target)+1)*condition_distance + .01*novelty; challenge + .01*normalized objective + .01*novelty; novelty + .05*normalized objective; negative condition distance + .001*normalized objective.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Defines how temporary edge losses, constraint progress and structural diversity trade off inside generated searches.
undeclared.resolution: Declared in A14; full components remain separately recorded.

undeclared.decision: Residual scale=max(sum absolute coefficients, residual interquartile spread over applicable archive graphs); objective normalization divides by abs(target)+1; a nonapplicable selected challenge uses -1e6.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Changes the numerical meaning and comparisons of the shared feedback reward.
undeclared.resolution: Declared in A19. Its last sentence has a separate remaining wording mismatch S03 if still present.

undeclared.decision: Program selection is graph-guided: collect programs that generated chosen parent graphs, then show the latest four by creation order. This is not a separate program-fitness ranking. Originally parent_program_ids included all originating programs, even sources not shown.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Determines what program evolution and its recorded lineage mean.
undeclared.resolution: A18 declares the policy. parent_program_ids now records only source_programs actually shown; parent_graph_ids records graph provenance separately.

undeclared.decision: The next lower call receives at most four prior failed-program records. Originally the record omitted program identity/source and stderr.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Without the actual failed source and diagnostic the model cannot repair a concrete failed program.
undeclared.resolution: A15 declares the bounded interface; F02 verifies ID, source, evaluation and stderr_tail are now passed.

undeclared.decision: A refuting held-out witness is disclosed after challenge, even though it is not in the discovery sample; at most four actual witness graphs are exposed per upper call.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Makes counterexample-driven refinement possible and changes the later meaning of holdout independence.
undeclared.resolution: A17 explicitly declares post-refutation disclosure and loss of independent holdout interpretation; F04 verifies the actual interface.

functional_defects.defect: Exact archived candidates received artificial positive novelty because their own reference graph was removed.
functional_defects.impact: A novelty-focused generated search could prefer exact repeats over unseen nearby constructions.
functional_defects.resolution: score defaults to including every frozen reference. Only select_parents requests exclude_self=True. Independently reran the same SearchAPI reproduction after the change.

functional_defects.defect: The next lower model call could not see a failed generated program or its actual runtime diagnostic.

reproduction.method: Two tiny Q2 rounds with a deterministic mocked lower provider and the actual offline upper provider. No paid calls.

functional_defects.impact: The advertised failure-repair feedback path was severed for runtime failures.
functional_defects.resolution: execute retains bounded stderr_tail; lower feedback carries ID, source and full evaluation. Independently reran the two-round reproduction.

functional_defects.defect: Rotating challenge targets by absolute round number aliases with the four-focus schedule.

reproduction.active_candidates: Four non-edge integer inequalities, each empirically supported on Q2 archive.

functional_defects.impact: With a stable four-candidate set, only one candidate ever drives a challenge-focused search.
functional_defects.resolution: Rotation now counts actual preceding challenge turns, including custom schedules. Read the helper and ran test_challenge_schedule_covers_four_candidates.

functional_defects.defect: Counterexample IDs were supplied without guaranteed witness metrics or edges; held-out refuting graphs remained invisible to the no-tools upper model.

reproduction.before: Status refuted and max_residual=3, but displayed discovery samples/clusters contained only the empty graph. The actual three-edge counterexample was identified only by ID.
reproduction.after: actual_counterexamples carries ID, dimension, edges, metrics, and refuted inequality IDs independently of discovery membership.

functional_defects.impact: Upper-side structural conjecture repair could not consume its own refutations.
functional_defects.resolution: Added bounded counterexample_view and actual_counterexamples to the actual upper prompt. Read the call site and ran test_heldout_refutation_is_visible_to_upper.

functional_defects.defect: The advertised exact registry sent to the model exposed base metric names but omitted specialized formulas, notably q7_J.

reproduction.before: Q8 configuration supplied q7_J_min and q7_J_sum over Q7 faces, but model input did not contain J=38448-126*edges+27*degree_3-44*degree_6-128*degree_7. Tool use was forbidden, so the formula could not be inspected.
reproduction.after: Registry.describe has base_definitions and dimension-specific face_base_definitions, including the exact Q7 polynomial and local-parity contract.

functional_defects.impact: The model could fit numbers but could not reliably interpret or reason about the shared indicator it was asked to use.
functional_defects.resolution: Read all new descriptions against the implemented formulas; test_face_metric_and_exact_counts checks exposure of the Q7 formula. No universal Q7 inequality is inferred.

correct_as_implemented: Accepted graph outputs are normalized and checked as simple ambient cube subgraphs. C4 validation cross-checks face counts with an independent common-neighbor counter.
Task conditions and each inequality's conditions are checked separately; an ineligible graph cannot satisfy the task goal or refute a conditional inequality outside its own scope.

Every applicable archived graph participates in refutation. Sample-supported candidates remain empirical. Only complete n<=3 enumeration can assign exhaustive_verified within its recorded finite domain.
Refuted candidates are excluded from later reward snapshots. New metric definitions trigger recomputation of archived metrics.
Offline and Codex providers are explicit; model failure is not silently replaced by an offline result. Requested model identity is not reported as independently observed identity.
Completed-round state is atomically saved; recorded successful provider calls and completed program evaluations are reused on resume.
limitations: Live Codex integration is Root's separate evidence; reviewer made no paid call and does not claim to have verified the returned live model identity.

No new Q8 search campaign, upper-bound proof, universal conjecture verification, or performance improvement was assessed. The existing seed unit test is a bounded witness check, not resumption of old research.

BUILD_NOTE was still being populated by Root during review. Its pending rung statuses are a work-in-progress record, not a positive acceptance claim; final publication should use Root's actual run record.
This review reports concrete current interfaces and observed defects. It proposes no hash scheme, security platform, or malicious-local-user threat model.
